name: Email Verification Send Flow Handler
summary: Provides the canonical application boundary for issuing or throttling email-verification proof while keeping delivery failure outside auth-state transition semantics.
notes: The latest durable verification proof CreatedUtc is the authoritative 60-second resend cooldown clock.
Delivery failures return a failed InvokeResult and are not treated as successful auth-state transitions.

sourceReferences.note: Send and resend share one typed canonical flow with Sent and Throttled outcomes.
